5.0.SP2.description: Specifies a specific source for a SecurityListType <1470> . Relevant when a certain type can be provided from various sources.

values.1: ICB (Industry Classification Benchmark) published by Dow Jones and FTSE - www.icbenchmark.com
values.2: NAICS (North American Industry Classification System). Replaced SIC (Standard Industry Classification) www.census.gov/naics or www.naics.com.
values.3: GICS (Global Industry Classification Standard) published by Standards & Poor
